1. A theme service that holds the current theme (Light/Dark/System) and
   a user's preferred accent color (string). Any component on any page
   should be able to read AND change these values.

2. When ANY component changes the theme (e.g., a toggle in the sidebar
   on one page), all OTHER components consuming the theme must immediately
   update — including components in the static layout area (like a theme

   switching to dark mode must not affect another user.

5. When navigating between pages (enhanced nav), the theme choice must
   persist without page reload.

What's the best pattern for sharing this state app-wide across all
pages and components, given the per-page interactivity setup?

Build succeeds. Here's a summary of the pattern and what was created:

---

### Pattern: Scoped Service + Interactive Islands + Cookie Persistence

**Why this works** with per-page interactivity:

| Concern | Solution |
|---|---|
| **Shared state** | `ThemeService` (scoped) — all interactive components on a page share the same circuit/DI scope |
| **Cross-component reactivity** | `OnChange` event — any subscriber calls `StateHasChanged()` |
| **Static layout update** | `ThemeIndicator` is an **interactive island** (`@rendermode InteractiveServer`) embedded in the static `MainLayout` |
| **Per-user isolation** | Scoped = one instance per circuit; each browser tab gets its own |
| **Persistence across nav** | Cookies (written via JS interop) — the circuit persists during enhanced nav, and SSR reads cookies to avoid theme flash |
| **System theme** | JS resolves `prefers-color-scheme` and watches for OS changes |

### Files created/modified:

- **`Services/ThemeService.cs`** — state container with `OnChange` event
- **`wwwroot/js/theme-interop.js`** — applies `data-bs-theme`, writes cookies, watches OS preference
- **`Components/Layout/ThemeIndicator.razor`** — interactive island in the header; hydrates from cookies on first render, applies theme via JS
- **`Components/Pages/Settings.razor`** — theme/accent picker page
- **`App.razor`** — reads `app-theme` cookie during SSR to set `data-bs-theme` on `<html>` (no flash)
- **`MainLayout.razor`** — added `<ThemeIndicator />` in top row
- **`NavMenu.razor`** — added Settings link
- **`Program.cs`** — registered `ThemeService` as scoped
